remark: BLM 'Seasons/Hours' line. Page: 'Campites and horse corrals are first-come, first-served'; only the group shelter is reserved (via the camp host), so the rec.gov calendar's 09-10 close is not a campground closing. Booking (reservable false, fcfs always) agrees.
Seasons of Use line; month-only edges. Chip closes 10-14. Neither the FS page nor the rec.gov facility text mentions first-come sites, so the calendar is not shown to be a booking window.

Seasons of Use line; the 10/23 (2024) close is 9 days after the chip's 10-14. Agency also gives the May open, which the chip lacks. rec.gov text: 'This popular campground is open from May through October'.

The FS page (slug agua-piedra-campground-and-group-shelters; the guessed agua-piedra-campground 404s) has no Seasons of Use line, only a 'Site Closed' header. rec.gov facility 234700 text gives no season ('Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'); it says 'First-come, first-served sites are available' and the group shelters are reservable. Carson newsroom releases and the High Road to Taos area page list no opening dates.

quote: Open year round unless closed due to weather concerns. The reservation season for this site is March 15 - November 30.
remark: Seasons of Use line. The chip's 11-30 close is the end of the reservation season (booking.season would be 03-15 to 11-30). Page: 'These 12 campsites are a mix of first-come first-served and reservation sites', matching booking fcfs some_sites.

quote: Generally mid-May until September 30th but is also seasonally dependent.
remark: Seasons of Use line. The open edge is given two ways on the same page: 'mid-May' (05-15) and, under Operational Hours, 'generally open from Memorial weekend until the end of September' (holiday-anchored, 05-25), so opens is left out. Chip closes 09-07 (Labor Day). Page calls it a 'reservation campground'; no first-come sites stated.

quote: End of May - End of September
remark: Seasons of Use line; 'End of' read as the last day. Chip closes 09-07 (Labor Day). rec.gov notice: 'Additional single-family sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis' (booking has no fcfs value). Current Conditions: 'Campground is open for use, with no fees' until snow closes the gate (off-season use, not a closure).

Seasons of Use says 'End of May - End of September'; Operational Hours says 'Peak seaaon May 19- September 7, 2025' then non-peak to Sept 30. Open edge given two ways (05-19 vs end of May), so opens is left out; both agree on the 09-30 close. Chip's 09-07 is the end of peak season. rec.gov notice: 'Additional single-family sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis' (booking has no fcfs value). Current Conditions: open with no fees until snow closes the gate.
